budget_comparison.included_costs: Video Agent output seconds only, assuming all allotted videos use the configured per-video time maximum. Shorter videos can cost less; this is not an unavoidable minimum for every trial. Avatar creation, payment processing, connector, hosting, conversion and other provider costs are excluded.

decision.reason: At the existing configured per-video time maximum, full Video Agent output seconds alone exceed both the trial hard cap and paid provider/script budget. Synthetic avatar creation alone does not verify a replacement for text script generation under the accepted contract. Retain the accepted pipeline and dedicated OpenAI billing precondition; do not change the price, quota or provider merely to bypass missing funding.
